page.layout: One page of running text, with four marginal references in the left margin. Running head at top, page number at top left. No catchword or signature.

main_text.p: Esaj.[?] 27. 1.pti (annon is Mahumet in Mecha situs?) visitabit enim duo quae Christo adversantur capita, Diaboli simul inter insulares Ethnicos plane exterminans dominatum: tunc Israel vinea ruboris dici poterit, ob multitudinem interfectorum, quos spirituali gladio mactabunt. Zach. 12.In die illa ponet Dominus Duces Iehuda, tanquam prunas ignis in lignis, & sicut lampadem ardentem in manipulis, devorabuntque ad dexteram & sinistram, omnes populos ipsos in circuitu: eritque qui infirmus fuerit in die illa, inter habitatores Ierusalaim, seu inter vera Ecclesiae veræ membra, is erit sicut David, expeditus in spiritu ad prosternendum gigantem. Et domus David seu Doctores eorum, erunt tanquam Dij, tanquam Angelus Domini coram eis. Soph. 2. 9.Residuum enim populi mei dicit Dominus, diripiet illos, & residuum gentis meae, possidebit illos: hoc contin-get illis propter superbiam, quod probris affecerint, & magnificaverint os suum, super populum Domini exercituum. Terribilis erit Dominus adversus illos, quoniam attenuabit omnes Deos terrae, & adorabunt eum, quisque de loco suo, & omnes insulae gentium. page.notes: Printed "Refiduum" and "fitus", "fuperbiam" etc. are long-s forms, rendered with plain s. "contin-get" at the line end: the word is hard to read and the hyphenation is not certain; marked as printed. Marginal references "Esaj." and "Zach. 8. 20." are doubtful readings. The first paragraph begins mid-sentence with "pti", continuing from the previous page. A small mark (possibly a signature "J") sits at the bottom left below the text; not transcribed because it is unclear whether it is a gathering mark. The running head is taken from the small capitals and may read "EVANGELII" in full.
